content.title: OXM Q2 Deep Dive: Margin Pressures and Tariff Mitigation Shape Results
content.summary: Fashion conglomerate Oxford Industries (NYSE:OXM) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2025, with sales falling 4% year on year to $403.1 million.
